name: Sahuarita Smash! (Sauce Edition)
description: A family platform fighter from Sahuarita, Arizona, on Windows and Android. Twelve fighters (Classic Games heroes, a roadrunner, a saguaro and a Gila monster, Teddy Roosevelt and Ben Franklin, the Firewall Knight, Paul Bunyan and Pecos Bill), seven stages with their own surprises (monsoon wind, a javelina stampede, mine carts, meteors, a lab laser, pecans from the orchard's tree shaker, a flash flood down the wash), up to four players against each other or the computer, and a ladder that ends against a giant. Nobody gets hurt: fighters get bonked and twinkle off the screen.
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), or Android 8 or later
A keyboard or game controller on Windows; touch controls on Android
Nothing else to install; works offline
